##### Swiftui Navigation

###### Resolved Issues

- Fixed: NavigationStack on macOS supports animated transitions. Either pass the `path` argument to `NavigationStack` with an animated binding (`$path.binding`), or mutate the path within a `withAnimation` body. The `transition` modifier now has an effect on pushed destinations. For example:

```None
segments.contextAfter: var body: some View { NavigationStack(path: $path.animation()) { VStack { List(0..<3) { int in NavigationLink(value: int) { Text("Animated Option") } } Button("Option 2") { withAnimation { path.append(3) } } } .navigationDestination(for: Int.self) { int in if int == 2 { colors[int].transition(.opacity) } else { colors[int] } } } .toolbar { Spacer() } } }
```
